claims.claim: Israel standard VAT rate is 18% (since Jan 1 2025, unchanged in 2026).
claims.raw_snippet: Vietnam Zambia Israel Corporate - Other taxes Last reviewed - 29 June 2026 Value-added tax (VAT) The 2025 current rate of VAT is 18%. Exports of goods and certain services and various other transactions are zero-rated, and certain transactions are exempt. Banks and other financial institutions pay VAT-equivalent taxes at the rate of 18% based on their total payroll and on profits. Not-for-profit organisations pay VAT-equivalent tax (wage tax) at the rate of 7.5% of their total payroll.
claims.verified_via: cited page fetched and confirmed to contain "18%"; snippet replaced with the page's own wording around it

claims.claim: 2026 salaried-employee National Insurance (Bituach Leumi) rates: employer 4.51% reduced / 7.60% full; employee 1.04% reduced / 7.00% full. Reduced rate applies up to 7,703 NIS (60% of average wage); full rate from there up to the 51,910 NIS maximum insurable income.

claims.claim: The allocation number is a condition for the RECIPIENT deducting input VAT, not a condition of the invoice's validity. An invoice without one is not void; the buyer cannot deduct mas tashumot.
